title: KCP space_participant_list request (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 read family)
description: Read: never mutates authoritative or user-visible state and never carries meta (closed shape — a read carrying meta, hence an idempotency key, fails; §11.2, R0 KENV-01). Lists the participants of one visible space. Cursor pagination per §11.5 (gap note KG9); participants are enumerated only within an exact space scope (§10.2 addressability; gap note KG9). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; connector service (only for its mapped resources) (assurance: current login or workload identity). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

space_id.description: Exact Space scope: participants are enumerated only within one visible space (gap note KG9 — filters and scopes never widen visibility).

args.description: Exact space scope plus the §11.5 query members { after?, limit, snapshot? }; offset pagination is prohibited (§11.5).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

pageLimit.description: Explicit page read limit; at most 512 (§11.8).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
